price_adjustment_rules_fields_valid.value: length(btrim("price_adjustment_rules"."name"))>0 AND "price_adjustment_rules"."currency"='KZT' AND "price_adjustment_rules"."scope" IN ('all','categories','variants') AND "price_adjustment_rules"."status" IN ('draft','active','archived') AND "price_adjustment_rules"."version">0 AND ("price_adjustment_rules"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "price_adjustment_rules"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "price_adjustment_rules"."ends_at">"price_adjustment_rules"."starts_at")

price_adjustment_rules_value_valid.name: price_adjustment_rules_value_valid

promotion_redemptions_fields_valid.name: promotion_redemptions_fields_valid
promotion_redemptions_fields_valid.value: "promotion_redemptions"."amount_minor">=0 AND "promotion_redemptions"."currency"='KZT' AND ("promotion_redemptions"."subject_hash" IS NULL OR "promotion_redemptions"."subject_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') AND NOT ("promotion_redemptions"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "promotion_redemptions"."subject_hash" IS NOT NULL) AND "promotion_redemptions"."expires_at">"promotion_redemptions"."created_at"

promotion_redemptions_state_valid.name: promotion_redemptions_state_valid

promotions_fields_valid.name: promotions_fields_valid
promotions_fields_valid.value: length(btrim("promotions"."code"))>0 AND "promotions"."code"=lower(btrim("promotions"."code")) AND length(btrim("promotions"."name"))>0 AND "promotions"."currency"='KZT' AND "promotions"."minimum_spend_minor">=0 AND "promotions"."status" IN ('draft','active','archived') AND "promotions"."scope" IN ('all','categories','variants') AND "promotions"."version">0 AND "promotions"."usage_epoch">=0

promotions_value_valid.name: promotions_value_valid
promotions_value_valid.value: ("promotions"."kind"='fixed' AND "promotions"."fixed_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "promotions"."fixed_minor">0 AND "promotions"."percentage_bps" IS NULL) OR ("promotions"."kind"='percentage' AND "promotions"."percentage_bps" IS NOT NULL AND "promotions"."percentage_bps" BETWEEN 1 AND 10000 AND "promotions"."fixed_minor" IS NULL)

promotions_limits_valid.name: promotions_limits_valid
